<function=python>
<parameter=code>
res = action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':59,'col':27},{'action':'MOUSE','row':58,'col':26}])
print({k:res.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','level_completed','done','game_over','reward','score')})
def pix(ascii_str, chars):
    out={}
    for i,line in enumerate(ascii_str.split('\n')):
        for j,ch in enumerate(line):
            if ch in chars: out.setdefault(ch,[]).append((i,j))
    return out
cur = pix(current_frame.ascii, 'WwM')
print('W', [p for p in sorted(cur.get('W',[])) if p[1]>5])
print('M', sorted(cur.get('M',[])))
print('w', sorted(cur.get('w',[])))
# diff last two transitions
def cells(frame):
    s=set()
    for i,line in enumerate(frame.ascii.split('\n')):
        for j,ch in enumerate(line):
            if ch not in 'Bg': s.add((i,j,ch))
    return s
for t in transitions[-2:]:
    b=cells(t.before_frame); a=cells(t.after_frame)
    print('action', t.action, 'added', sorted(a-b)[:15], 'removed', sorted(b-a)[:15])
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

def pix(ascii_str, chars):
    out={}
    for i,line in enumerate(ascii_str.split('\n')):
        for j,ch in enumerate(line):
            if ch in chars: out.setdefault(ch,[]).append((i,j))
    return out

def cells(frame):
    s=set()
    for i,line in enumerate(frame.ascii.split('\n')):
        for j,ch in enumerate(line):
            if ch not in 'Bg': s.add((i,j,ch))
    return s
for t in transitions[-2:]:
    b=cells(t.before_frame); a=cells(t.after_frame)
    print('action', t.action, 'added', sorted(a-b)[:15], 'removed', sorted(b-a)[:15])
